people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
translations.bsb: Jesus asked the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw?
translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
